gloss: here you are; please go ahead; yes, certainly

definitions.gloss: here you are; please go ahead; yes, certainly
definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when handing something to someone, when granting permission or inviting someone to proceed, or when responding affirmatively to a request or knock.

examples.japanese: 「お{水|みず}をいただけますか。」「はい、どうぞ。」
examples.english: "Could I have some water?" "Here you are."

examples.japanese: 「この{資料|しりょう}を{見|み}てもいいですか。」「はい、どうぞ。」
examples.english: "May I look at these documents?" "Yes, please go ahead."

examples.japanese: {店員|てんいん}は「はい、どうぞ」と{言|い}いながら、{商品|しょうひん}を{手渡|てわた}した。
examples.english: The store clerk said "Here you are" while handing over the item.

notes:
Used as a polite response when handing something to someone or granting a request. The はい affirms the request and どうぞ invites the action.

USAGE:
- {物|もの}を{渡|わた}すとき (when handing something over): はい、どうぞ
- {許可|きょか}を{与|あた}えるとき (when granting permission): はい、どうぞ
- ドアをノックされたとき (when someone knocks): はい、どうぞ お{入|はい}りください

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どうぞ: please; go ahead — used alone when handing things or permitting
- さあ、どうぞ: here you go — slightly warmer/more inviting tone
